I.name: Identity
I.description: Does nothing. Sometimes doing nothing is a choice.

X.name: Pauli-X
X.description: Bit flip: swaps the |0⟩ and |1⟩ amplitudes.

Y.name: Pauli-Y
Y.description: Bit and phase flip: α|0⟩+β|1⟩ → −iβ|0⟩ + iα|1⟩.

H.name: Hadamard
H.description: Rotates between the Z and X bases: |0⟩ → |+⟩, |1⟩ → |−⟩.

CNOT.name: Controlled-NOT
CNOT.description: Placed on a corner. Flips the target (⊕) qubit when the control (●) qubit is |1⟩. Both qubits must cross the corner together. Click a placed CNOT to swap control and target.

CZ.name: Controlled-Z
CZ.description: Placed on a corner. Negates the |11⟩ amplitude of the two qubits crossing it together.
